nameOfQualification: Certificate in Digital Graphics and 3D Design
description: Developed in collaboration with Cosmos Maya India Pvt Ltd, the role focuses on basic skills in graphic design, visual communication, and 3D content creation. It emphasizes design principles, color theory, typography, and layout composition for both print and digital media. The candidate will also learn basic editing, motion graphics, 3D modeling, texturing, and lighting techniques. The qualification includes essential soft skills to support communication, teamwork, and workplace readiness. Basic knowledge of computer operations and English is required for effective functioning in the design and digital media environment.
